coverage.note: Gov data.gov.il dataset = 606 records (authoritative national floor). Community aggregators (mikveh.co.il ~1,470) include men's + vessel-immersion + diaspora, so they overstate Israeli operational women's mikvahs. Religious councils + municipalities add ~227 structured local records with richer fields (hours, attendant, accessibility) that the gov dataset often lacks — strongest value is enrichment + verification, not raw count.
